items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Then I’d send him to Dick Shanahan, to show him how to move the hands right you know.

ctx.x: Okay, so if you had a drum student, could you define what it is to swing?

The first thing I would do if I had a drum student, I’d send him right over to Snooky Young, and let’s sit down at the drums and play along with Snooky Young and show him how to phrase. Snooky Young knows just how to phrase those big band figures. Then I’d send him to Dick Shanahan, to show him how to move the hands right you know. And then get rid of him.
In other words you’d be a subcontractor.
